tag_line: Tag the friend you call after a bad day.

rank.line: Hears what you said, and what you didn't.
Puts the phone face down. Pours you tea.
rank.plus: Makes space for whatever you need.

rank.line: Nods, asks one good question, then waits.
rank.plus: Helps you find your own answer.

rank.line: Remembers the tiny thing you said in May.

rank.plus: A calm mountain when you're shaky.

caption:
Which element is the best listener? 👂

In Chinese astrology your element comes from the day you were born. The yin elements are the receivers: Yin Water reads what isn't said, Yin Earth makes room for you, Yin Wood asks the question that helps. Yang Earth sneaks in as the calm mountain.

Find your element free at the link in bio.
